card.name: Ends of drug-interaction terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a multi-part pharmacology term in interaction text, such as steady-state, ACE inhibitors, hormonal contraceptives, or CYP3A4. The next word is usually a noun like Cmax, drug name, or inhibitors.

modes.label: ACE inhibitors
modes.description: The word inhibitors right after ACE in NSAID interaction warnings.
modes.example: The antihypertensive effect of ACE<< inhibitors>>, including lisinopril, may

modes.description: The final part of terms like CYP3A4 or steady-state, before the noun they modify.
modes.example: no clinically significant pharmacokinetic interaction between desvenlafaxine and CYP3A<<4>> substrates (Figure 2).

modes.label: Contraceptives and others
modes.description: The ending of a drug class name in a heading, or a stray number or space inside a measurement phrase.
